clause: Interop fixture + round-trip harness (15-target native fixture plan) [STU-IO-011]

scope.summary: Implement the fixture + round-trip test harness that every format family MT plugs into: representative fixtures + receipts for each supported app-and-direction; round-trip expectations stated as a BOUNDED fidelity envelope (not 'identical') verified by fixture comparison rather than capability memory. Seed the native 15-target fixture plan by family — Affinity (5), Figma family (6), Illustrator (3), InDesign (2), Photoshop (2) — each declaring all four support directions (import, edit-preserve, export, round-trip) and its schema-public status (documented interchange XML / partly-documented native / vendor-private native / vendor-private-or-PDF-compatible / vendor-private local-copy / vendor-private template) governing how much is semantically imported versus preservation-blobbed.
acceptance_criteria: fixture + bounded round-trip harness live; 15 native targets seeded; no memory-asserted parity
expected_tests: test: round-trip harness compares import->export against a bounded fidelity envelope (not identity)
test: 15 native targets registered by family with 4 directions + schema-public status
test: a format with no passing fixtures is not parity-complete

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: Format claims asserted from memory; no round-trip proof surface.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
